summary: Official West Bengal and Paschim Bardhaman sources evidence the Banglarbhumi land-record custodian and mouza/plot map procedures relevant to Durgapur. Anonymous parcel schema/CRS/geometry retrieval was not completed because the direct portal request timed out and the public portal indicates login for citizen services. No GeoJSON sample is retained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Bengali discovery queries are recorded in the city record. English results identified Banglarbhumi, Paschim Bardhaman district land records, Basundhara State Geoportal, and DoLR. Bengali results corroborated the official West Bengal land-record service family but did not identify a separate Durgapur parcel API.
requestOutcomes: The direct Banglarbhumi GET timed out after 20 seconds. Indexed official portal content was inspected for service names and access conditions. Basundhara's public page was inspected and states departmental registration is required. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe field request, TLS disablement, formal submission, or contact was used.
